36 36 equivalents Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period 635 344 89 588 182 (163) Commentary on the results The Board of Directors is pleased to announce the unaudited results for the half-year ended 30th June 2025. The same accounting policies and methods of computation have been used as were in the comparable periods’ financial statements. Business commentary During the half-year ended 30 June 2025, Group’s revenue grew by 20% to Kes 7.4 billion from Kes 6.2 billion in June 2024. The Group’s profit before tax stood at Kes 548 million compared to Kes 147 million for the period ended 30 June 2024. The growth in revenue is mainly due to increase in sales volumes as we continued to deliver differentiated and innovative customer propositions. In addition, the Kenya Shilling remained stable against major world currencies during the period ended 30 June 2025, ensuring stable prices for imported raw materials and thereby supporting overall profitability. Performance outlook The Board expects the strong first-half performance to be sustained to the year-end. DIVIDEND The Board of Directors does not recommend payment of an interim dividend. By Order of the Board Conrad Nyukuri, Company secretary 29th August 2025
